summary: Episode discussing AP7 Såfa, the default pension fund option in Sweden's premiepension system. The hosts explain why it's a good default choice (low fees, global index fund, tax advantage) while discussing pros and cons including leverage and automatic de-risking after age 56. They emphasize checking your default fund and not getting manipulated into poor alternatives.
key_takeaways: AP7 Såfa is recommended as the default pension fund choice due to low fees (0.05%), global diversification, and tax advantages
Check your pension fund selection on minpension.se - many people have poor default choices from decades ago
AP7 has leverage (~15%) which can increase returns but adds complexity
The fund automatically shifts to bonds after age 56, which may not suit high-risk investors
All hosts use AP7 Såfa themselves
